# id: # Fishing methods real players use, numbers from the OSRS Wiki (see source). "?" = makes it, rate not on the wiki.

name: Net fishing shrimps and anchovies
note: wiki 1,500-3,000 xp/h at 1 (fish/h = xp / 10), 7,500 once anchovies come at 15, then 150-280 of each fish an hour

name: Bait fishing sardines and herring
note: wiki 3,000-8,000 xp/h; fish and bait per hour are our estimate from xp (20 / 30 xp a fish)

name: Fly fishing trout and salmon (drop)
note: the wiki AFK rates (3-tick is faster but click-heavy); feathers = fish per hour, our estimate from xp (trout 50, salmon 70)

name: Fly fishing trout and salmon (bank at Ferox Enclave)
where: Barbarian Village, bank at Ferox Enclave
note: wiki ~26,000 xp/h banking raw at 20-40; the trout/salmon split is our estimate

name: Lobsters
note: wiki 111-333 lobsters an hour; xp = lobsters x 90; the 60 row is the middle of that range (estimate)
source: OSRS Wiki Money making guide/Catching lobsters 2026-10-25

name: Tempoross
note: regular harpoon, not cooking; cooking the harpoonfish (22k at 35, 52k at 70) is the iron way to the infernal harpoon; loot from the reward pool

name: Barbarian Fishing (leaping fish, drop)
note: the wiki AFK rates; also Agility and Strength xp (5-7 a fish); 30/30 for salmon, 45/45 for sturgeon; feathers are our estimate from xp

name: Aerial fishing
note: plus Hunter xp (39,600/h at 35 Hunter); 2,400 catches an hour; bait = offcuts cut from the catch, or king worms on the island
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Fishing training + Aerial fishing 2026-10-25

name: Karambwanji (bait for karambwan)
where: Holy Lake, south of Tai Bwo Wannai (fairy ring CKR)
note: 5 xp a net, several karambwanji a catch; no per hour rate on the wiki

name: Karambwan
note: karambwan per hour = wiki xp / 50; about 10% slower without a fish barrel

name: Sharks
where: Fishing Guild docks (68 to enter, +7 hidden boost) or Catherby
note: wiki ~90 an hour at low levels, 170+ much higher; xp = sharks x 110
source: OSRS Wiki Money making guide/Catching sharks 2026-10-25

name: Drift net fishing
where: Fossil Island underwater (talk to Ceto: 200 numulites a day or 20,000 for good)
note: plus Hunter xp (60,145/h at 44 Hunter, 116,725 at 70); wiki: 1,150 shoals an hour, 80-110 drift nets an hour (95 is the middle); fishbowl helmet + diving apparatus and stamina potions recommended; fish chosen at Ceto
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Fishing training + Drift net 2026-10-25

name: Anglerfish
where: Port Piscarilius, the spot south of Tynan's Fishing Supplies
note: wiki ~15,000 xp/h at 82 and 23,000 at 90 with sandworms; fish (and worms) per hour = xp / 120
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Fishing training + Raw anglerfish 2026-10-25
